description: This file defines the internal model and interface for a Camera Device in a smart camera system, including data structures, enums, and function prototypes for device management, configuration, monitoring, firmware upgrades, and media operations.

classes.name: cameraDevice
classes.description: Struct representing a camera device with properties such as identifiers, credentials, status, capabilities, and callback for attribute changes.

methods.name: createCameraDevice
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new cameraDevice object, optionally gathering additional device info.

methods.name: destroyCameraDevice
methods.description: Destroys a cameraDevice object and stops its monitor thread if active.

methods.name: cameraDeviceConfigure
methods.description: Configures the camera device based on a provided descriptor, possibly reconfiguring credentials.

methods.name: cameraDeviceSetWiFiNetworkCredentials
methods.description: Sets the WiFi SSID and WPA2 passphrase for the camera.

methods.name: cameraDeviceEnableMotionDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables motion detection on the camera.

methods.name: cameraDeviceSetMotionDetectionSensitivity
methods.description: Sets the sensitivity level for motion detection.

methods.name: cameraDeviceStartMonitorThread
methods.description: Starts a thread to monitor the device's status and events.

methods.name: cameraDeviceStopMonitorThread
methods.description: Stops the device monitoring thread, optionally waiting for it to terminate.

methods.name: cameraDeviceResetToFactory
methods.description: Resets the camera device to factory defaults.

methods.name: cameraDeviceCheckForUpgrade
methods.description: Checks if the device firmware needs an upgrade based on version comparison.

methods.name: cameraDevicePerformUpgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade on the camera, blocking until completion.

methods.name: cameraDeviceCheckFirmwareValue
methods.description: Checks and updates the firmware version, notifying if changed.

methods.name: cameraDeviceReboot
methods.description: Reboots the camera device and optionally waits for it to come back online.

methods.name: cameraDevicePing
methods.description: Pings the device to check if it is online.

methods.name: cameraDeviceCreateMediaTunnel
methods.description: Establishes a media tunnel session with the camera.

methods.name: cameraDeviceDestroyMediaTunnel
methods.description: Destroys an existing media tunnel session.

methods.name: cameraDeviceGetMediaTunnelStatus
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving media tunnel status (not implemented).

methods.name: cameraDeviceTakePicture
methods.description: Captures a picture and saves it locally.

methods.name: cameraDeviceTakeVideoClip
methods.description: Captures and uploads a video clip.
